event: 2025 ILCA 6 Women's & ILCA 7 Men's World Championships
procedural_matters: The race committee was represented by Sandy Grosvenor (Course Representative).
HKG 211717 was represented by Nancy Highfield.

The hearing was scheduled at 17:45. HKG 211717 did not come to the hearing initially when the hearing commenced at 17:50. Immediately after the hearing was decided as valid, HKG 211717 arrived at the hearing room. The hearing was restarted at 17:55 with both parties present.
facts: The course axis for race 3 of the ILCA 6 Blue fleet was set at 130 degrees and the length of leg 1 was 0.65 NM.
When the starting signal was made, the average wind across the course area was 7-8 knots.
On the first upwind, the wind shifted 10 to 15 degrees on either side of the course axis, and the wind decreased to an average of 5 knots.
On the second upwind, the race committee signalled a change of course to the right of 15 degrees and decreased the length of the leg at mark 4S/4P.
The relative positions of the fleet across the course area remained similar throughout the race.
conclusions: There was neither an improper action nor improper omission of the race committee. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
